responsibility: Implements the core Nios II target backend in C++, tying together ABI handling, option processing, builtin registration/expansion, address legitimacy and PIC handling, frame layout and prologue/epilogue generation, operand printing, section and small-data decisions, TLS and thunk support, late reorganization, and custom-instruction bookkeeping. It owns the target hook definitions for this port, the per-function machine state used during RTL expansion, and helper routines used by the .md files to validate or synthesize Nios II-specific RTL and assembly output.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name nios2 files, this is the executable C++ implementation file: it defines the backend's target hooks, option validation/override logic, builtin expansion, frame and address handling, and other helper routines that consume interfaces from nios2.h, options from nios2.opt, and patterns described in nios2.md.
